text:
All 10 tests pass.

Fixed three bugs in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`**: Replaced `list(set(items))` with an order-preserving implementation that tracks seen items.
2. **`partition`**: Swapped the return order from `(no, yes)` to `(yes, no)` so matching items come first.
3. **`windows`**: Changed the range stop from `len(items) - k` to `len(items) - k + 1` so the final window is included.
